about: Focused scheduler regression mutants, run with their named killers. Model searches reserve all scheduler slots for memory isolation.

mutants.name: b15-r8-run-memory-reservation-disconnected
mutants.rule: The running gate connects MemoryHeavy to an exclusive slot reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-model-memory-unreserved
mutants.rule: Every model search declares a full-gate memory reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-slot-undercharged
mutants.rule: A queued memory-heavy step reserves all requested slots, not one.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-immediate-undercharged
mutants.rule: An immediate memory-heavy reservation also takes all requested slots.

mutants.name: gf3-shards-dealt-by-wall
mutants.rule: A package with recorded CPU rows deals its shards by CPU, not wall time.

mutants.name: gf3-hang-floor-at-go-default
mutants.rule: No go test step's deadline is go test's 15 minute default.

mutants.name: gf3-build-step-without-deadline
mutants.rule: Every go test command of a step passes -timeout.

mutants.name: gf3-shard-deadline-ignores-cost
mutants.rule: A shard's deadline is ten times its recorded cost.

mutants.name: gf3-pause-keeps-the-span
mutants.rule: A paused test's wait is not its CPU.

mutants.name: gs3-fast-runs-all
mutants.rule: The fast tier's examples step runs only the programs of scripts/examples/fast-tier.txt; the full tier runs every default program.

mutants.name: gs4-coverage-ignored
mutants.rule: A function body's edit runs the tests whose recorded blocks it touches.

mutants.name: gs4-reads-ignored
mutants.to: moved[i] = false && readState(root, r.Path, r.Lookup) != r.State
mutants.rule: A file, directory or lookup a test read that is now otherwise runs that test.

mutants.name: gs4-env-ignored
mutants.rule: A variable a test read whose value changed runs that test.

mutants.name: gs10-shared-gotmpdir
mutants.rule: The record runs each test with its own GOTMPDIR, so the shared one's listing, which every go build changes, is no read that selects a test.

mutants.name: gs4-declaration-as-body
mutants.rule: An edit outside every function body (a constant, a declaration) runs every test: no block holds it.

mutants.name: gs4-one-hunk
mutants.from:
keepA, keepB, ok := myersKeep(a, b)
	if !ok {
mutants.to:
keepA, keepB, ok := myersKeep(a, b)
	if !ok || true {
mutants.rule: Two edited function bodies of one file are two hunks, each judged in its function (the line diff), not one span across both.

mutants.name: gs4-skip-unwired
mutants.rule: A test the selection skips joins the names every shard of the package skips.

mutants.name: gs6-chain-ignored
mutants.rule: A step's priority adds the longest chain of the steps that need it.

mutants.name: gs6-times-ignored
mutants.rule: A step's recorded time on this host replaces its declared weight.

mutants.name: gs6-last-not-longest
mutants.rule: The longest of a step's kept times weighs it, not the last, so a run that replayed most of the step does not start it last next time.

mutants.name: gs6-run-ignores-priority
mutants.rule: The gate's slots go by stepPriorities, not the declared weight alone.

mutants.name: gs6-times-unwritten
mutants.from: if err := writeStepTimes(g.cacheDir, times, g.steps, results); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := writeStepTimes("", times, g.steps, results); err != nil {
mutants.rule: A run records its steps' times in the gate cache for the next run.

mutants.name: gs6-keep-all
mutants.rule: The times file keeps each step's last stepTimesKept times: it does not grow with every run.

mutants.name: gs6-failed-recorded
mutants.rule: A failed step's time, cut short, is not recorded.

mutants.name: gs6-examples-unweighted
mutants.rule: The fast tier's examples step, its longest, weighs the most of its steps.
